title: Golfclub Achensee Pertisau
highlights: Tyrol's oldest golf club, proudly established in 1934
Scenic 18-hole championship course situated on the shores of Lake Achensee
Gently contoured fairways set against the dramatic backdrop of the Karwendel mountains
Welcoming clubhouse featuring a panoramic sun terrace and refined regional dining
kurzbeschreibung: Golfclub Achensee in Pertisau is the oldest golf club in Tirol, delighting players with its 18-hole course set against the Karwendelgebirge.
beschreibung:
Time-Honoured Golf by the Tyrolean Sea

Golfclub Achensee in Pertisau boasts a rich tradition: founded in 1934, it is the oldest and most established golf club in all of Tirol. Situated at almost 950 metres above sea level, the pristine 18-hole par-72 championship course nestles harmoniously along the shores of scenic Achensee.

Alpine Golfing Pleasure by the Karwendel

The fairways gently roll across alpine meadows right at the entrance to the ruggedly romantic Karwendeltäler. The combination of level terrain, challenging hazards, and unobstructed views of the rugged Karwendelgebirge makes every round of golf an unforgettable sporting and nature experience. After the round, the cosy clubhouse invites players to relax and dine.
